issues.description: The Farm class public song method is named inconsistently across artifacts. The problem statement (and the template) require a public method named singFarmSong() (problem_statement.md references singFarmSong() and the template declares public void singFarmSong()), but the reference solution implements the same functionality under the different name playFarmSong() (solution/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java declares public void playFarmSong()). This naming mismatch can confuse students about which method to implement or call and may break automated checks that look for singFarmSong().
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Rename the solution method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() method in the solution that delegates to playFarmSong(). Alternatively, if playFarmSong() was intended, update the problem statement and template to reference playFarmSong() instead.
